# RGS Modular Animated Characters

This project uses a local, unmodified CC0 reference download only for testing
hand-authored walk-cycle timing and body-part motion. It is not the final game
art style.

- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/free-cc0-modular-animated-vector-characters-2d
- Original download page: https://rgsdev.itch.io/free-cc0-modular-animated-vector-characters-2d
- License: CC0 / public domain, as stated in `License.txt` in the downloaded archive.
- Local download and extracted files are ignored by Git because the archive is large.
